entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to make a return. I just don't think they're going to work out for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a customer for years, I've never had to return anything before. I feel bad about it.

No need to feel bad at all, we want you to be happy with your gear. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Velo Carbon cycling shoes. And thank you for being a VIP member with us, we really appreciate your loyalty.
Oh. Thanks. It's just... I saved up for these. I was so excited.
I completely understand. To make sure I'm getting this right, what specifically was the issue with the cycling shoes? Was it a sizing problem or something else?
They just hurt so much. I tried setting up my cleats and went for one short ride, and I came back with terrible blisters on my heels. They're just not the right shape for my feet.

Oh, that sounds incredibly painful. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let's get this sorted for you right away. I see you received them just six days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, that's a relief. I was so worried because I'd worn them once. I really needed that money back for the holidays. Are you sure I can get a full refund?

Absolutely. I am processing the return authorization for a full refund right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow, that was... easy. Thank you so much, Sarah.

You are very welcome. And since you're a long-time VIP customer, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for the inconvenience. Maybe you can find a different pair of shoes that will be a perfect fit. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
You did not have to do that! That's so nice of you. I really appreciate it. You've made my day so much better.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
